title: Near-extinct snails rescued from rock 濒临灭绝的蜗牛从岩缝中获救

paragraphs.zh: 英国动物园的保育人员成功繁育出 300 只濒临灭绝的小型蜗牛，并将它们重新放归野外。

paragraphs.en: Less than a centimetre in size, these tiny snails had been pushed to the brink of extinction .
paragraphs.zh: 这些体长不足一厘米的小型蜗牛一度濒临灭绝。

paragraphs.en: Their home on the Madeira Archipelago had been grazed bare by invasive goats and rabbits, while mice saw the molluscs as a water source.
paragraphs.zh: 它们在马德拉群岛上的栖息地被入侵的山羊和兔子啃食殆尽，而老鼠则将这些软体动物当作水分的来源。

paragraphs.en: But after conservation work, including a breeding programme at Chester Zoo, hundreds of the snails have now been returned to the wild. The team said they had one shot to save the species.
paragraphs.zh: 不过，在实施了一系列动物保护措施后，包括切斯特动物园的一个繁育项目，数百只蜗牛如今已经被重新放归野外。研究团队表示，他们只有这一次机会来拯救这一物种。

paragraphs.en: The mission involved transporting them in the dark to snail-friendly crevices in the rocks. It's hoped they come out of their shell to restore soil and boost the natural habitat.
paragraphs.zh: 此次行动包括在夜间将这些蜗牛转移到适宜生存的岩石缝中。人们希望它们能从壳中爬出、重新活跃起来，从而帮助恢复土壤环境，促进当地生态栖息地的恢复。
